rules.accepted_credit_types: General hours approved by a state or national body that accredits nursing CE; mandatory subjects (except human trafficking) must come from Florida Board of Nursing approved providers; live or home study
rules.new_licensee_rule: Nurses first licensed by exam (or by endorsement after an exam in another state) in the current biennium skip the general hours but must do 2 h medical errors, 2 h laws and rules, 2 h impairment in the workplace, 2 h human trafficking and 1 h HIV/AIDS; licenses held under 24 months need 1 hour per month.
rules.alternatives: Certification by a specialty program accredited by NCCA or ABSNC exempts from CE (not from the 2-hour human trafficking course); report it in CE Broker.
rules.notes: 24 hours = 16 general + mandatory subjects; domestic violence (every third biennium) is on top of the 24 hours. CE must be reported in CE Broker. RNs renew in three groups (current expirations Apr 30 2027, Apr 30 2028, Jul 31 2028).
rules.rule_quote: Domestic Violence is required every third biennium and the hours are in addition to the 24 hours required for renewal.
